summary: The milestone completed 9 synthesis-only experiments in 84.5 minutes, with 0 compute-bound experiments. Typed transition witnesses for live world-model refinement was the longest entry at 41.09 minutes, but the available timing data does not identify the phase or cause behind that duration.
bottlenecks_identified: Synthesis wall time was concentrated in Typed transition witnesses for live world-model refinement (41.09 minutes), V638 source ingestion and sealed execution map (21.21 minutes), and Prospective continuous self-learning with bounded coverage memory (16.65 minutes).
Disk-mtime reconstruction provides experiment totals but no phase-level timing, so the cause of the longest synthesis durations cannot be determined from the available data.
improvements_suggested: Emit structured elapsed-time spans at synthesis stage boundaries so source ingestion, implementation, validation, and artifact writing can be distinguished.
Add a readiness-aware synthesis queue that can overlap experiments only when their declared inputs prove they are independent.
Save restartable state at completed synthesis stages and write conductor-owned lifecycle timestamps instead of inferring timing from disk mtimes.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Add readiness-aware overlap for synthesis experiments with satisfied, independent inputs.
Emit structured elapsed-time spans for every synthesis stage.
Persist restartable stage state with conductor-owned lifecycle timestamps.
meta_reflection: GPU idleness was expected because the milestone contained no compute-bound experiments, so it is not an operational fault. The next optimization should target synthesis orchestration, but missing stage attribution and a measured counterfactual require the savings estimate to remain zero.
